source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: Five lines above a two-turn dialogue in the share-page shape: a line of text, an indented line 'Report', and a closed code block that holds the words 'log in'.

Apple drops what stands above the first speaker line, whatever it is. The web app drops such lines only when they are the top of a share page, and it looks for page furniture only among the lines that its cleaner could remove. 'Report' is indented and 'log in' stands inside a closed code block, so neither is a sign of a page top: the five lines are kept as a note.
